Class CloudManager

java.lang.Object
com.mygame.cloud.CloudManager
public final class CloudManager extends Object
Renders a deterministic volumetric cloud layer and updates its motion and lighting. Cloud noise and wind direction derive from world.seed; the cloud texture is generated on the CPU, and each world starts with a zero wind offset.

The dome is drawn in the Sky bucket after opaque geometry. It is attached after SkyManager, so the terrain occludes clouds, clouds can appear in front of the sun, and water-reflection cameras see the same cloud layer.
